notes.drawing: Side view, direction A: a shell dome on a flat base, a pill head raised forward on its neck, two stubby feet and a short tail. The dome is half an ellipse (168 wide, 96 high, as cubics); the sketch's half circle was 120 units tall beside rabbit's 232, so the dome got taller, the head moved up and the feet got longer: it now spans y 48 to 200 (152 units), about as tall as Phosphor's car-profile and as wide as bird. One line across the shell (y 116) marks its rim; shell plates filled in at 16 px in round 1, this single line stays open (36 units to the base).
notes.fill: Solid, with the rim cut as a white band, the way bug-beetle-fill cuts its head off. The band runs out through the back of the shell but stops 8 units short of the front, so it doesn't cut into the neck. The tail stays a line.
